name: Japan Racing Association (JRA)
desc: Government-owned special public corporation that organises central horse racing in Japan and runs pari-mutuel betting on it.
products: Horse racing at 10 racecourses, pari-mutuel betting on-course, off-track (WINS, J-PLACE) and online
marketing_autonomy_basis: Special public corporation overseen by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries; marketing budget authority not confirmed
parent_backing: Capital (JPY 4.92bn) fully funded by the national government (ja.wikipedia)
stores_or_sites: 10 racecourses plus WINS / J-PLACE off-track sites; overseas offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, Sydney
markets: Japan nationwide; liaison offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong and Sydney

fin.value_orig: JPY 3.538 trillion operating revenue (事業収益)
JPY 3.485 trillion betting sales (売得金), +5.2% y/y

fit_rationale: JRA sells a premium live-sport betting product to the same Japanese male audience as the Suzuka Grand Prix; F1 could support its younger-fan acquisition and Japan Cup international profile.

access.roles: Director of Public Relations; Marketing Planning Department head

compliance: State-regulated monopoly under the Horse Racing Law; betting-product sponsorship rules for F1 broadcast markets need checking.
outstanding: Whether JRA buys sponsorship outside horse racing; marketing budget; reconcile 1,690 vs 1,815 staff.

name: Loterías y Apuestas del Estado (SELAE)

products: Lotería Nacional, El Gordo, La Primitiva, Bonoloto, Euromillones, La Quiniela football pools
customers: Spanish lottery players via retail network and online
marketing_autonomy_basis: Sociedad Estatal attached to the Ministry of Finance
stores_or_sites: Retail lottery network (over 11,000 indirect employees per infobox)
markets: Spain; partner in pan-European Euromillones with nine operators

access.roles: Director de Marketing; Director de Comunicación

compliance: State monopoly; Spanish gambling-advertising rules (Real Decreto 958/2020) restrict sports sponsorship by private operators; SELAE's position under them needs checking.
outstanding: Sponsorship history and advertising rules; 478 vs ~600 staff.
